mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS 3-month growth > 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases over 3 months.
